decisions.reason: Certified HVAC gasketed plate heat exchangers are core to the portfolio and serve steady demand, so withdrawal is unlikely despite the lack of recent website evidence.
The marine box cooler line holds a major market share in water cooling systems and supports recurring service business.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line and the marine service offering, though as a single product it is somewhat more exposed to consolidation.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established competence and serves industrial and transportation customers with ongoing demand.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reflect the firm's R&D and efficiency focus, although the earlier withdrawal of finned tubes shows tube products face some portfolio pruning risk.
